name: Nagaizumi (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Nagaizumi town emblem in white: a stylised angular character of horizontal and diagonal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Nagaizumi, a town in Shizuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 25 January 1956.

features.role: Nagaizumi town emblem — a stylised angular character of horizontal and diagonal strokes
